name: Yasukaze Motomiya
bio: Yasukaze Motomiya is a Japanese actor renowned for his prolific work in V-Cinema. With extensive experience in combat sports, including mixed martial arts (MMA) and boxing from a young age, he brings authentic physicality to his roles. He has appeared in numerous V-Cinema films, with his most notable work being the ongoing Unification of Japan (日本統一) series (2013-present).
